answer_4.quote: We conducted a short (10-15 minute) listening test to compare the two Tacotron2 models that trained properly (10h, full) against the seven FastSpeech2 models. We recruited 30 participants through Prolific
answer_4.guideline: Participants ranked voices using MUSHRA-style questions, answered A/B preference tests, and responded to MOS-style ratings.
